prompt: Name a current NFL or MLB team named for a bird.
label: Getting Harder
note: Closed by current roster of two specific leagues (NFL, MLB) as of 2026 — eight teams. Franchise relocations/renamings are rare but do happen (the Washington NFL franchise and Cleveland's MLB team both changed names this decade); re-check this list if either league's lineup shifts, same as any closed-by-current-membership round.

answers.name: Philadelphia Eagles
answers.fact: NFL. Named in 1933 for the Blue Eagle, the New Deal-era NRA's compliance emblem — not for the bird directly.

answers.name: Baltimore Ravens
answers.fact: NFL. Named by a fan vote for Edgar Allan Poe's 'The Raven' — Poe is buried in Baltimore.

answers.name: Seattle Seahawks
answers.fact: NFL. A seahawk isn't a distinct species — the name refers to the osprey, which hunts fish along the coast.

answers.name: Arizona Cardinals
answers.fact: NFL. The oldest continuously run professional football franchise in the US, dating to 1898 in Chicago.

answers.name: Atlanta Falcons
answers.fact: NFL. Named via a 1965 fan contest; the winning entry called the falcon 'proud and dignified, with great courage.'

answers.name: Toronto Blue Jays
answers.fact: MLB. The only current bird-named team outside the two Cardinals and the Orioles, and the only one based outside the US.

answers.name: Baltimore Orioles
answers.fact: MLB. Named for Maryland's state bird, which is itself named for Lord Baltimore's family colors.

answers.name: St. Louis Cardinals
answers.fact: MLB. Named for the color of their uniform trim before anyone decided to match it to an actual bird.

distractors.name: Pelicans
distractors.note: That's the NBA's New Orleans Pelicans — this round is NFL and MLB only.

distractors.name: Hawks
distractors.note: That's the NBA's Atlanta Hawks — this round is NFL and MLB only.

distractors.name: Penguins
distractors.note: That's the NHL's Pittsburgh Penguins — this round is NFL and MLB only.

distractors.name: Ducks
distractors.note: A real bird, but that's the NHL's Anaheim Ducks — the wrong two leagues.

distractors.name: Columbus Blue Jackets
distractors.note: Not actually bird-named at all — the NHL's Columbus team, probably confused with the Blue Jays.

distractors.name: Kansas Jayhawks
distractors.note: A mythical mashup, not a real bird — and Kansas is college ball, not the NFL or MLB anyway.

distractors.name: Air Force Falcons
distractors.note: A real bird name, but Air Force is college football, not the NFL.

distractors.name: Atlanta Thrashers
distractors.note: A real bird name, but the Thrashers were NHL, and the franchise relocated to Winnipeg in 2011.

distractors.name: UNC Wilmington Seahawks
distractors.note: Also bird-named, but that's college basketball, not the NFL.
